💪 Motto of Physical Education – KUCE&T
At KUCE&T, the Physical Education motto emphasizes holistic development including physical fitness, mental well-being, and strong moral character.
Vision
KUCE&T envisions a vibrant sports culture where games such as Badminton, Football, Volleyball, Handball, Table Tennis, Lawn Tennis, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Chess, and Cricket are actively incorporated.
Yoga and Martial Arts are integrated to nurture mental focus and inner peace.
Mission
Fostering all-round growth with physical and mental resilience
Instilling discipline, team spirit, and sportsmanship
Emphasizing stress management, focus, and fair play
Introduction
The academic year 2024–25 marked an eventful and successful sports journey for KU College of Engineering and Technology (KUCE&T), KU Campus, Kakatiya University.
Under the dedicated guidance of
Dr. Kota Sridhar Kumar
, the Physical Education department actively organized and participated in various tournaments at university, district, state, and national levels.
This report highlights the participation, achievements, and overall contribution of the students and staff in promoting a vibrant sports culture at KUCE&T.
